purpose: Exposure (how close the buildings are to water) vs the regulatory and monitoring apparatus (how close oversight is to the buildings).

compound_blind_spot.definition: within 300 ft of a mapped stream AND no own NPDES permit AND no DEQ monitoring station within 1 mile

community_observation_layer.note: Research-grade community observations exist near most sites while official monitoring does not -- the citizen layer is denser than the regulatory one.

headline: The buildings sit a median 303 ft from a mapped stream (49% within 300 ft, closest 1 ft), yet 100% hold no NPDES discharge permit of their own and 100% have no VA DEQ monitoring station within a mile -- in fact NOT ONE of the 243 buildings does. 118 buildings (49%) are simultaneously stream-adjacent, unpermitted for discharge, and unmonitored. Proximity to water is high; proximity of oversight to the water is nil.
